title: Virgin and Continent; the Inverted Face; the Five Births of the Body
description: Recognition deepening through structure, image, and offspring. T88 — the twelve openings of the body (seven sense-faculties above, five lower outlets below): the soul that recognizes these for what they are has already begun the contest, and to recognize the self working through them is to prevail over it. T89 — why the image of what is above appears cast downward in still water: the inversion is the form of the Call descending to the lower; and the rising face still shown downward signs the Answer ascending. T90 — how what the soul receives bears fruit at five registers (breath, voice, discharge, conjunction, somatic offspring); the soul recognizes only the last as its child, but all five are equally born from the nourishment given.
